dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, have you heard? Something serious has happened with the higher-ups...

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Ah... you mean what happened with The Doctor and Marionette, right?

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: *sigh* For this to happen just as the pl{RUBY#[D]Project Stuzha}an was about to kick off...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Look at you, worrying over nothing again, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: The Jester and The Rooster are leading the charge on that front. There's no way it could fail.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: No matter what happens in Nod-Krai, it won't affect Her Majesty the Tsaritsa's great endeavor. We need only carry out our duties and wait to sing the praises of her farsighted wisdom, you'll see!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Hmm... I hope things really do go smoothly over in Snezhnograd...
